//go:build upgradeseed

package store

import (
	"os"
	"testing"
)

// TestUpgradeSeed seeds a database at $UPGRADE_SEED_DB using this tag's store.
func TestUpgradeSeed(t *testing.T) {
	path := os.Getenv("UPGRADE_SEED_DB")
	if path == "" {
		t.Skip("UPGRADE_SEED_DB not set")
	}
	s, err := New(path)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	// Users: alice (admin, TOTP via users columns), bob (plain), carol (totp table).
	alice, err := s.CreateUser("alice", "alice-password-1")
	must(t, err)
	must(t, s.SetRoles(alice.ID, []string{"admin", "user"}))
	bob, err := s.CreateUser("bob", "bob-password-2")
	must(t, err)
	carol, err := s.CreateUser("carol", "carol-password-3")
	must(t, err)
	// users.totp_* legacy columns for alice.
	_, err = s.db.Exec(`UPDATE users SET totp_secret='JBSWY3DPEHPK3PXP', totp_enabled=1 WHERE id=?`, alice.ID)
	must(t, err)

	// Sessions (full, partial) - far-future expiry so they read back.
	for _, c := range []struct{ id, kind string }{{alice.ID, "full"}, {bob.ID, "partial"}} {
		_, err = s.db.Exec(`INSERT INTO sessions (token, user_id, kind, expires_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, '2099-01-01T00:00:00Z')`,
			"seed-session-"+c.kind, c.id, c.kind)
		must(t, err)
	}

	// API tokens (hash of a known raw token for alice).
	_, err = s.db.Exec(`INSERT INTO api_tokens (id, user_id, name, token_hash, prefix, scopes) VALUES
		('tok-1', ?, 'ci-token', ?, 'mct_seedtok1', '["read","write"]'),
		('tok-2', ?, 'readonly', 'deadbeef', 'mct_seedtok2', '["read"]')`,
		alice.ID, sha256Hex("mct_seedtoken_alice_0000000000000000"), bob.ID)
	must(t, err)

	// TOTP table (carol).
	must(t, s.SetTOTPSecret(carol.ID, "KRSXG5CTMVRXEZLU"))
	must(t, s.VerifyTOTPSetup(carol.ID))

	// WebAuthn credentials + sessions.
	must(t, s.AddWebAuthnCredential(alice.ID, []byte("seed-passkey-alice-1")))
	must(t, s.AddWebAuthnCredential(alice.ID, []byte("seed-passkey-alice-2")))
	must(t, s.AddWebAuthnCredential(bob.ID, []byte("seed-passkey-bob-1")))
	_, err = s.db.Exec(`INSERT INTO webauthn_sessions (challenge, user_id, data, expires_at) VALUES ('seed-challenge', ?, x'01020304', '2099-01-01 00:00:00')`, alice.ID)
	must(t, err)

	must(t, s.Close())
}

func must(t *testing.T, err error) {
	t.Helper()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
